title: Juniper and the Tryouts
author: Ada Hartwell
blurb: Mara Thornbury, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide who to be when the labels come off before the last game of the season.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
